thread:
lucy: FYI prospect (Northbridge Capital) needs a 2-week POC to validate BYO-HSM integration before PO. Ask: CMK in customer CloudHSM, key ceremony evidence, rotation dry-run, and cost estimate for sustained 8k req/s with p99 < 120ms. Can we commit?
omar: Short: we can do a limited POC. Main constraints: HSM attestation lead time, and whether their HSM supports wrapped key import or we need a traffic-proxy.
rae: Security checklist from them: FIPS 140-2 level 3, attestation doc, firmware signing digest, and 90-day key usage logs to their SIEM. Also they require a non-exfiltration guarantee in writing.
sales-eng: Procurement asks for a rough SOW line item: one-time attestation + setup + monthly ops. Need ranges to budget (they want to include in internal approval).
lucy: Can we outline the POC approach and a quick perf test they can run? Also include a fallback if perf fails.
omar: Proposed POC plan: 1) Network peering + minimal staging VPC. 2) Customer HSM in their subnet; we run a KMS proxy that issues wrapped session keys. 3) Redwood runtime configured to call HSM via mTLS for unwraps; ephemeral session keys cached per instance. 4) Canary traffic only; 48h soak.
rae: For rotation dry-run: create new KEK in HSM, tag instances to warm caches, then switch routes. We can script it with our rotation-runner but need small changes for BYO (no export allowed). Estimate dev work: 1.5 engineer-days.
sales-eng: Budgetish numbers?
omar: Quick calc: if every request did a full KEK unwrap it would blow up. With session-caching and batching, key-op cost amortized. Ballpark HSM add-on + ops: $7k9k/mo; one-time integration + attestation: $18k9k (depends on attestation depth). Put as ranges.
lucy: Legal: can we provide the "non-exfiltration" statement? They want: "CMKs never leave customer HSM in plaintext under Redwood operations."
legal: We can sign a limited statement: "Redwood will not export CMK plaintext from customer-managed HSM during normal operations and POC. For attestations and proofs, Redwood may provide signed vendor attestation documents and logs." Need to review vendor attestation docs first. Also we need an exceptions clause for emergency recovery with customer approval.
rae: Note: some HSMs don't allow wrapped-key import. If so we'll propose a split-KEK approach or a wrapping proxy in their VPC. Need to capture that as an engineering assumption.
sales-eng: Perf test script (suggested) — run from customer test VM to exercise full path with their HSM: 
```
#!/bin/bash
for i in {1..5000}; do 
  seq -f "curl -s -X POST https://redwood-staging.example/v1/gen -H \"Authorization: Bearer $TEST_TOKEN\" -d '{\"prompt\":\"ping\",\"max_tokens\":1}'" -j 50 | xargs -P50 -I{} sh -c '{}' &
done
wait
# measure p95/p99 via histogram collector
```
Explain this will hit unwrap path on cold instances. Recommend warmup run.
omar: Additions: ask customer to create a read-only service account for audit forwarding and a test HSM partition for POC. This cuts compliance friction.
lucy: Action items: @omar draft tech appendix + runbook (EOD tomorrow). @rae draft security one-pager for questionnaire and send to legal. @sales-eng prepare SOW ranges and fallback clause (fallback: Redwood-managed CMK for POC only, with customer's consent, if p99 cannot be met).
infra-bot: POC workspace created: https://redwood.internal/pocs/1746001234 (ticket #POC-1746001234). Please tag owners.
lucy: Also flag timeline: attestation lead time 2-6 weeks depending on vendor; call that out. We'll propose start date in 3 weeks to be safe.
legal: One more ask: can we include a clause that we will publish any vendor firmware hash used during attestation? We typically can share vendor-provided hashes but not internal procurement docs. We'll try to get permission.
rae: I'll collect exact SIEM log format they need (CEF vs JSON) and add to runbook.
sales-eng: I'll send a concise budget + SOW draft to procurement and cc legal.
lucy: Thanks team. I'll propose a kickoff with customer next Tue. :raised_hands:
